sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx:Quality Checks!A33:D33; Internal Quality Checks!A33:D33; full Quality and Deterministic id inventory
evidence: Two concrete probe gaps are detailed in per-row-review/evidence/32/review-notes.md. First, task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:430-434 makes post-restart current-record, write and history comparisons from a fresh page but does not require a clean independent browser context or server-supplied data after restart; judge.toml:332-343,584-588 gives those outcomes to cw_process_restart_durability, cw_process_restart_write and cw_history_restart. The pre-restart server-data gate at prompt.md:5 does not close that gap. Second, prompt.md:466,468 uses historical sources with console.log as their sole execution effect and checks only log counts; judge.toml:528-532 credits cw_history_inspection_no_execution. A muted-console inspection execution can pass. The public behaviour.md requires history inspection without running source and saved records/history to survive process restart. Workbook Quality Checks!A33:D33 and frozen quality-checks.md:134-136 require distinctive browser evidence. The 96-criterion inventory is in evidence/32/criterion-inventory.json. All 77 indexed artifact hashes matched. Golden scripted results do not test these broken-app cases and no configured judge/Oracle/model/portal run is present.
counterexample: A browser app initially persists the gate record to its server and shares it with an independent clean context, but mirrors later library/history to localStorage. Its server loses those records and snapshots on process restart; the original Playwright context opens a fresh page and renders the cached entries, and a cached post-restart Save/read appears successful. S22's UI comparisons can pass despite lost shared durability. Separately, inspecting an older revision evaluates its console.log-only source in the preview while muting forwarded console calls; the marker counts stay flat, so S37's no-execution criterion can pass despite execution.
suggested_fix: For S22, after the completed restart read every recorded current identity/history snapshot from a new storage-empty browser context and verify server-supplied data, then verify the post-restart Save via observed accepted write and independent fresh read. For S37, add a historical source with a distinctive DOM effect and verify preview state is unchanged during inspection alongside the console counts; keep the working Run control.
